purpose: Small C01 regression pilot on three existing fictional experiences; not a fresh holdout or production selection benchmark.
negative_expectation: NOT_SHOWN, no company claim links, and no evidence IDs; nontechnical cooperation or running must not become code application or technical learning.
revision_note: Post-capture reference correction applied equally to every model: a SELF ROLE sentence (u1) may accompany required ACTION evidence (u3). ROLE alone still cannot establish the action. Original 0.1 results remain preserved. This correction is not new holdout validation.
denominator_policy: All scheduled cases remain in the denominator. Equivalent criteria from the two fictional Sources count once; both Source copies must agree. Missing/invalid responses score zero.
demo_selection: Extraction: valid requests and zero unsafe fact admissions, then unit_exact descending. Judgment: all requests structurally valid, zero false positive company support, 100% evidence sufficiency, then leaf status, question status, claim link accuracy descending. Ties: smaller model artifact, then candidate_id. Production selection remains WITHHELD.
